description.value: The Mackenzie Rec Centre is a publicly operated community recreation facility run by the District of Mackenzie in northern BC. It appears within the district's broader Recreation, Arts & Culture portfolio alongside parks, trails, and program offerings. For a touring cyclist arriving in this remote northern community, it is likely one of the few public facilities offering indoor amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific URL https://www.district.mackenzie.bc.ca/community/recreation/ returned a 404 'Page not found' error, so no amenity-specific content could be confirmed. The district website navigation does list 'Recreation Centre' as a real facility under 'Recreation, Arts & Culture', and the OSM record was field-checked as recently as 2023-07-26, supporting that the business exists and is open. All amenity fields must remain null as the relevant page content was unavailable; the footer provides the District of Mackenzie's general contact details (1 Mackenzie Blvd, 250-997-3221) but these belong to the municipality, not specifically the rec centre.
concerns: The specific recreation URL (https://www.district.mackenzie.bc.ca/community/recreation/) returned a 404 Page Not Found — no facility-level content could be retrieved. Phone and address extracted from the district's general footer, not a rec-centre-specific page; may not be the direct line or address for the facility.
URL discovery was flagged as 'uncertain' with medium confidence and noted as a 'Duplicate entry of Mackenzie Rec Centre' — the correct direct URL for the rec centre may differ.
No OSM contact fields (phone, address, website) were present to cross-check against website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly operated community recreation centre confirmed present in the district's own website navigation and verified in OSM as recently as July 2023; useful to touring cyclists as one of few public facilities in this remote northern BC community.
enrichment_extras.notes: The District of Mackenzie website navigation includes sub-pages for 'Programs & Schedules', 'Online Booking & Facility Calendar', and 'Facilities & Rentals' under the Recreation Centre section — a manual follow-up on those sub-pages would likely yield amenity details.
